/* ==========================================================================
   Typography tokens (Catalyst Design System 2.0) — two layers, like the Figma library
   (collections "3. Typography primitives" and "4. Typography semantic").

   1. Primitives: font families (tokens.css), weights (tokens.css), letter-spacing steps (below),
      and the size scale --font-size-s|m|l|h3|h2|h1|display-* (size/line-height pairs per density,
      Density block in tokens.css).
   2. Semantic: one set per text style, named like its .t-* class (.t-body-m-regular -> --font-body-m-regular). Components and prototypes use ONLY these:
        font:var(--text-<style>)
--font-tracking-minus-06: -0.6px
